740f1236: ;Set X to '?BAD' to indicate bad data input.
8d764559: Quit if the input is null, otherwise set DZ variable to input X, execute code labeled D, execute QQ^DIEQ, and go to label B.
4f18495e: Set D variable to DIFLD, set DQ(DQ) array element to concatenation of DLB, U, DV, U, DU, U, DW, U, and $P($T(@("X"_DQ))," ",2,99).
4d2dc565: If DE(DQ) is undefined, execute O and go to RD if X is not "@", go to A if DV doesn't contain "R" and X is "@", go to X if X is "@". Set X to Y and go to N.
1acd4f7d: Set DG to DV, Y to DE(DQ), X to DU. If DQ(DQ,2) is defined, execute DQ(DQ,2). Go to RP.

594e34ad: If DG contains "P" and ^(0) node exists in X global, set X to second piece of ^(0) node. If ^(Y,0) node doesn't exist, go to RP. Otherwise, set Y to first piece of ^(0) node, X to third piece of DD(X,.01,0) node, and DG to second piece of ^(0) node. Execute R again.

cfbdbf71: If DG contains "V" and Y is non-zero, second piece of Y delimited by ";" contains "(", and 0 node exists in @(U_second piece of Y_"0)") global, set X to second piece of that 0 node. If ^(+Y,0) node doesn't exist, go to RP. Otherwise, set Y to first piece of ^(0) node. If DD(+X,.01,0) node exists, set DG to second piece of that node and X to third piece of that node. Execute R again.
f2ab1604: If DG contains "D", execute ^DD("DD"). If DG contains "S", set % to piece after Y in X delimited by ";", and if % is not null, set Y to %.
e9e01222: Execute O. If X is null, set X to DE(DQ). If DV is null, go to A. If DC is less than 2, go to A. Otherwise, go to N^DIE17.
e4b34679: If DV does not contain "I" or "#", go to RD.
9be1c406: Execute E^DIE0. If X is defined, go to RD. Otherwise, go to PR.
7ba6030e: Quit.
58fa0d19: Set DNM to "DGJXA5", DQ to 1.
7bf6ee83: If DG is defined and value is greater than 9, execute F^DIE17 and DE. Set DQ to 1, DW to "0;11", DV to "R*P393.2'", DU to null, DLB to "STATUS", DIFLD to .11.
57a311eb: Set DU to "DG(393.2,".
8a422401: Set X to DGJTST.
88a656e8: Set Y to X.

4874c916: Set X to Y, DB(DQ) to 1. If X is null, go to N^DIE17 if DV is defined, otherwise go to A. If DE(DQ) is defined and DV contains "I" or "#", execute E^DIE0. If X is undefined after that, go to A.
0d529d67: If X is defined, go to Z. Otherwise, go to RD.
